title: Reschedule by moving the event in your calendar
text:
Drag a meeting to a new time in Google or Outlook, and NeetoCal reschedules the booking to match. Client notified, no second trip into NeetoCal.

Manage your day from the calendar you already have open.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/reschedule-by-moving-the-event-in-your-calendar

title: Restore video links after reconnecting video tool
text:
Zoom dropped for an hour and ten bookings got Jitsi links? NeetoCal now fixes them for you.

Reconnect, and every upcoming booking gets your real video link back. No emails to clients, nothing to click, no afternoon of cleanup.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/restore-video-links-after-reconnecting

title: Control who can change a booking's host
text:
New NeetoCal permission: "Change host for the booking".

Choose which roles can reassign a booking to someone else. Hosts keep managing their own meetings, and nobody hands one off without your say.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/change-host-permission

title: Resend and signing notifications for contracts
text:
Chasing contract signatures in NeetoCal just got shorter.

Resend a contract from the booking when the first email got lost. And a new "Contract signed by both parties" webhook lets your tools start the next step the moment it is signed.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/contract-resend-and-signing-updates

title: Webhook for incomplete bookings
text:
A client starts a booking, then leaves before paying. Your tools used to hear nothing.

NeetoCal's new "Booking incomplete" webhook sends the reason, so you can follow up and recover the booking.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/webhook-for-incomplete-bookings?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webhook-for-incomplete-bookings

title: Webhook for video link or meeting place changes
text:
Your CRM no longer keeps the old video link.

NeetoCal has a new webhook event, "Video link or meeting place changed". It fires with the old and new values, so every connected tool stays in sync and nobody joins the wrong call.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/webhook-for-video-link-or-meeting-place-changes

title: Customize colors in Gallery and Map sections
text:
The Gallery and Map sections on NeetoCal intro pages now take your colours.

No more two sections that clash with the rest of your page. Set them in the editor and the whole page looks like it was built on purpose.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/customize-colors-in-gallery-and-map-sections

title: Automatic recording for Teams meetings
text:
Stop opening Teams after every booking just to turn on recording.

Set it once on your NeetoCal scheduling link. Every Teams meeting booked through it records and transcribes from the start.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/automatic-recording-for-teams-meetings?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automatic-recording-for-teams-meetings

title: Update calendar preferences using the API
text:
Creating scheduling links from your own system? No need to open each one in NeetoCal to pick calendars.

The API now sets where bookings go and which calendars are checked for double bookings.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/update-calendar-preferences-using-the-api?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=update-calendar-preferences-using-the-api

title: Clearer integration disconnection emails
text:
An integration dropped. Which one? What breaks? What now? NeetoCal's disconnection email now answers all three at a glance: what stopped, who connected it, why, and a reconnect button.
To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/clearer-integration-disconnection-emails?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=clearer-integration-disconnection-emails

title: Manage add-on services using the API
text:
A client picks an add-on in your own booking flow. Now the NeetoCal booking can carry it.

The API can also list, create, update and delete a scheduling link's add-on services.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/manage-add-on-services-using-the-api?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=manage-add-on-services-using-the-api

title: Block specific email addresses from booking
text:
One person keeps booking, and blocking gmail.com would shut out everyone. You can now block a single email address from booking meetings or buying packages. Existing bookings stay as they are.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/block-specific-email-addresses-from-booking?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=block-specific-email-addresses-from-booking

title: Social media links in the intro page footer
text:
A client likes your intro page and wants to follow you. Your intro page footer can now link to your Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and Twitter profiles. One click, no hunting around.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/social-media-links-in-the-intro-page-footer?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=social-media-links-in-the-intro-page-footer

title: Charge a client's saved payment method
text:
Booking a recurring series for a client who has paid you before? Charge their saved payment method for every session, no payment link to send, no chasing. Each session is charged before it starts.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/charge-a-client-s-saved-payment-method?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=charge-a-client-s-saved-payment-method

title: Override notifications for a scheduling link
text:
Not every scheduling link needs the same alerts. You can now pick which emails and SMS each link sends, so a confirmation SMS stays on for one link and off for another. No all-or-nothing switch.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/override-notifications-for-a-scheduling-link?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=override-notifications-for-a-scheduling-link

title: Apply a discount when booking for a client
text:
Booking a paid meeting for a client with a discount code? Enter it on the payment step and the payment link you send already has it applied. The client pays the discounted amount, nothing to explain.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/apply-a-discount-when-booking-for-a-client?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=apply-a-discount-when-booking-for-a-client

title: Lists and subheadings on intro pages
text:
Intro page descriptions no longer have to be one block of text. Add bulleted or numbered lists, subheadings, underline and strikethrough. A new About us 6 layout gives longer text full width.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/lists-and-subheadings-on-intro-pages?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=lists-and-subheadings-on-intro-pages

title: Customize approval and rejection emails
text:
Your booking emails sound like you. The approval and rejection ones did not. You can now edit the approval request, the pending email and the rejection email, and add your reason when you decline.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/customize-approval-and-rejection-emails?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=customize-approval-and-rejection-emails

title: Send automations only to first-time clients
text:
Your regulars don't need a welcome email every time they book. NeetoCal automation rules can now send an email or SMS only to first-time clients, only to returning clients, or to both.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/send-automations-only-to-first-time-clients?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=send-automations-only-to-first-time-clients

title: Reschedule a group meeting for everyone
text:
A group session has to move. Pick a new time once and everyone who booked moves with it. Each person gets an updated invite, reminders and the calendar event move too, and you get a single email.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/reschedule-a-group-meeting-for-everyone?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=reschedule-a-group-meeting-for-everyone

title: Images on intro page service cards
text:
Some services are easier to show than to describe. Intro page service cards can now carry an image, so clients see what each service looks like before they book. Pick the Services 5 variant.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/images-on-intro-page-service-cards?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=images-on-intro-page-service-cards

title: Automatic redirect to your custom domain
text:
You set up a custom domain, but old links still open on your NeetoCal subdomain. Not anymore. Public pages now redirect to your custom domain, and links you've already shared keep working.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/automatic-redirect-to-your-custom-domain?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automatic-redirect-to-your-custom-domain

title: Customize meeting appearance before picking a calendar
text:
Want to set the meeting name and body before you pick a calendar? Now you can. Customize how meetings look whenever it suits you; we save the layout and use it as soon as you choose a calendar.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/customize-meeting-appearance-even-before-connecting-calendar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=customize-meeting-appearance-even-before-connecting-calendar

title: Assign to the first responder in the group
text:
A ticket routed to a group should stay with that group. New automation actions assign to the first or last responder from the assigned group, counting only that group's replies. Outside replies no longer pull it away.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/assign-to-the-first-responder-in-the-group?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=assign-to-the-first-responder-in-the-group

title: Individual customer satisfaction responses
text:
A low CSAT rating used to be a number without a story. The satisfaction report now lists every response with its ticket, customer, rating and comment. Click a rating card to filter, open the ticket, see what went wrong.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/individual-customer-satisfaction-responses?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=individual-customer-satisfaction-responses

title: Follow and unfollow tickets
text:
Want to keep an eye on a ticket that isn't yours? Open the Followers section in the ticket sidebar and click Follow. You'll get an email for every reply. Done watching? Click Unfollow.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/follow-and-unfollow-tickets?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=follow-and-unfollow-tickets

title: Ticket status in search results
text:
Three tickets with the same subject. Which one is still open? NeetoDesk search results now show each ticket's status as a tag beside the number, in the label and color you set, so you can tell before opening any of them.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/ticket-status-in-search-results?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ticket-status-in-search-results

title: NeetoEngage integration
text:
Customer asks for a feature in a ticket? Add a private note starting with "fr" and NeetoDesk sends it to NeetoEngage as a new request or a vote, without leaving the ticket. Early access.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/neetoengage-integration?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=neetoengage-integration

title: Cc people when creating a ticket
text:
Creating a ticket for a customer and need to loop someone else in? Add them in Cc right on the new ticket form in NeetoDesk. No more creating the ticket first and adding Cc in your first reply.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/cc-people-when-creating-a-ticket?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cc-people-when-creating-a-ticket

title: IP restriction
text:
You can now limit access to your NeetoDesk workspace to specific IP addresses or ranges, so only your office network or company VPN can reach your data. Admin Panel > IP Restriction. Your own IP is added automatically.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/ip-restriction?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ip-restriction

title: Slack thread link on tickets
text:
No more searching the channel for a ticket's Slack thread. When an automation rule posts a NeetoDesk ticket to Slack, the sidebar now shows a View in Slack link.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/slack-thread-link-on-tickets?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=slack-thread-link-on-tickets

title: Attach files to ticket updates and drafts through the API
text:
The NeetoDesk API can now attach files when you update a ticket or save a draft reply, not only when creating one. Large files go straight to storage via Reserve an attachment upload. The MCP server can attach too.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/attach-files-to-ticket-updates-and-drafts-through-the-api?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=attach-files-to-ticket-updates-and-drafts-through-the-api

title: Search inside ticket conversations
text:
Remember what the customer said but not the ticket number? NeetoDesk search now looks inside messages, replies and notes, and shows the matching text under each result.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/search-inside-ticket-conversations?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=search-inside-ticket-conversations

title: Filter tickets by customer or custom field through the API
text:
The List tickets API can now return one customer's tickets, by email or customer ID, or only tickets with a given custom field value. Store an account ID in a custom field and fetch all its tickets in one call.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/filter-tickets-by-customer-or-custom-field-through-the-api?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=filter-tickets-by-customer-or-custom-field-through-the-api

title: Ticket details in reply and note webhooks
text:
NeetoDesk webhook events for new replies and notes now include the ticket's ID and number. Your system knows which ticket each reply belongs to without a second request. Covers customer replies, team replies and notes.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/ticket-details-in-reply-and-note-webhooks?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ticket-details-in-reply-and-note-webhooks

title: Choose which ticket view opens first
text:
Your team works from the Active view, but NeetoDesk always opened Unresolved. Not anymore. NeetoDesk now opens the first view in each agent's sidebar. Reorder your views under Admin Panel > Ticket views and that's it.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/choose-which-ticket-view-opens-first?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=choose-which-ticket-view-opens-first

title: Use the original sender as the customer for forwarded emails
text:
A customer emails a team member, who forwards it to support. The ticket should belong to the customer, not the forwarder. NeetoDesk now uses the original sender as the customer for forwarded emails, on by default.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/forwarded-emails-now-create-tickets-for-the-original-customer?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=forwarded-emails-now-create-tickets-for-the-original-customer

title: Rename built-in ticket statuses
text:
Your team calls it Triage. NeetoDesk called it New. You can now rename built-in statuses like New, Open and Closed to match the words your team uses. Only the label changes; automations, views and macros keep working.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/rename-built-in-ticket-statuses?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=rename-built-in-ticket-statuses

title: Import your support history through the API
text:
Moving to NeetoDesk? Bring your tickets with you. The Create ticket and Create comment APIs now accept original dates, author email, attachments and your old ticket ID. Real dates are kept, and notifications stay off.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/import-your-support-history-through-the-api?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=import-your-support-history-through-the-api

title: Custom ticket fields API
text:
Custom ticket fields can now be managed through the NeetoDesk API: list, create, update and delete. Create a dropdown with hundreds of options in one request, rename it later, add or remove options, or deactivate it.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/custom-ticket-fields-api?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=custom-ticket-fields-api

title: Automatic replies kept out of your inbox
text:
Out-of-office replies no longer create tickets in NeetoDesk. Autoresponder emails outside an existing conversation go to spam. On an existing ticket they're added as a reply, with no auto-acknowledgement, so no loops.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/automatic-replies-kept-out-of-your-inbox?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automatic-replies-kept-out-of-your-inbox

title: Watch time and engagement analytics
text:
Did anyone watch your recording to the end? NeetoRecord analytics now show average view duration, engagement, and which parts viewers watched, skipped or rewatched.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/watch-time-and-engagement-analytics?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=watch-time-and-engagement-analytics

title: Emoji reactions on recordings
text:
Viewers can now react to a NeetoRecord recording with an emoji at the exact moment they're watching. Each one becomes a marker on the progress bar, so you can jump to the moments people responded to.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/emoji-reactions-on-recording?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=emoji-reactions-on-recording

title: Video uploads and more in the API, MCP and CLI
text:
Already have the video? Upload an MP4 of up to 2 GB to NeetoRecord straight from the API or CLI, no trip to the browser. AI assistants on the MCP server can do it too.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/video-uploads-and-more-in-the-api-mcp-and-cli?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=video-uploads-and-more-in-the-api-mcp-and-cli

title: Action items from your recordings
text:
No more rewatching a recording to find the follow-ups. Once NeetoRecord has a transcript, the Action Items tab lists them with a timestamp to the moment each came up. Viewers can tick them off.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/action-items-from-your-recordings?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=action-items-from-your-recordings

title: System audio in the web recorder
text:
The NeetoRecord web recorder can capture tab and system audio again. When Chrome asks what to share, say yes to audio too, and viewers hear both you and whatever is playing on screen. Pro plan.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/system-audio-in-the-web-recorder-2?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=system-audio-in-the-web-recorder-2

title: Recover unfinished recordings
text:
A browser crash mid-recording no longer costs you the take. NeetoRecord keeps what was already uploaded and offers to recover it next time you open the recordings page or the Chrome extension.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/recover-unfinished-recordings?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=recover-unfinished-recordings

title: One question at a time forms
text:
NeetoForm can now show one question per screen. Respondents answer, hit Next, and move on, which keeps a long survey from feeling like a wall of fields. Pick it when you create a form from scratch.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetoform.com/changelogs/one-question-at-a-time-forms?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=one-question-at-a-time-forms

title: Multi-step forms with page breaks
text:
Long forms in NeetoForm can now be split into pages. Add a Page break where a new page should start. Respondents fill one page at a time, and nothing is lost when they go back.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetoform.com/changelogs/multi-step-forms-with-page-breaks?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=multi-step-forms-with-page-breaks

title: Automation rules that read as a sentence
text:
Automation rules in NeetoForm now read like a sentence: when a submission is created, then send an email to the submitter. Pick each part in order, and the builder says why an option can't be used.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetoform.com/changelogs/automation-rules-that-read-as-a-sentence?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automation-rules-that-read-as-a-sentence

title: Redesigned automation rule builder
text:
NeetoChat's automation rule builder now shows each rule as a sentence, so you see what it does at a glance. The two email actions are now one Send email action. Existing rules keep working.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/redesigned-automation-rule-builder?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=redesigned-automation-rule-builder

title: Conversation names in unread-message emails
text:
When a visitor misses your reply in NeetoChat, the email now names the conversation in the subject and body, so people with several chats know which one you answered.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/conversation-names-in-unread-message-emails?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=conversation-names-in-unread-message-emails

title: Unread replies when the widget is hidden
text:
If your site hides the NeetoChat widget behind its own help button, visitors could miss a reply. Turn on Show widget on new reply and the launcher reappears with an unread badge.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/unread-replies-when-the-widget-is-hidden?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=unread-replies-when-the-widget-is-hidden

title: Look up contacts with the API
text:
Integrations can now look up NeetoChat contacts directly through the API, by ID, email or user identifier, without going through one of the person's conversations first.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/look-up-contacts-with-the-api?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=look-up-contacts-with-the-api

title: Block specific email addresses from booking
text:
NeetoCal now lets you block a single email address from booking.

A blocked address can't book any of your scheduling links or buy packages, and the bookings they already have stay as they are. Add it from the Admin panel or straight from the client's booking.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/block-specific-email-addresses-from-booking?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=block-specific-email-addresses-from-booking

title: Ticket details in reply and note webhooks
text:
Reply and note webhooks in NeetoDesk now include the ticket's ID and number.

Your system can tell which ticket each reply or note belongs to without making another request. This covers replies from customers, replies from your team, and notes added by your team.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/ticket-details-in-reply-and-note-webhooks?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ticket-details-in-reply-and-note-webhooks

title: Emoji reactions on recordings
text:
Viewers can now react to a NeetoRecord recording with emoji.

A reaction is pinned to the moment the viewer was watching and shows as a marker on the progress bar. Click a marker to jump to that spot, or hover to see who reacted. You get a quick read on which parts of a recording landed.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/emoji-reactions-on-recording?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=emoji-reactions-on-recording

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #ScreenRecording

title: System audio in the web recorder
text:
You can record system audio from the NeetoRecord web recorder again, on the Pro plan.

When Chrome asks what to share, choose to share its audio as well. NeetoRecord mixes it with your microphone, so a product demo with a video playing comes out with both voices intact. It works the same way as the Chrome extension and desktop app.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/system-audio-in-the-web-recorder-2?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=system-audio-in-the-web-recorder-2

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #ScreenRecording

title: Action items from your recordings
text:
NeetoRecord now lists the action items from a recording for you.

Once the transcript is ready, the Action Items tab shows every follow-up task with a timestamp that jumps to where it was mentioned. Add, edit or delete items as needed, and viewers can mark them complete. Nobody has to rewatch the whole thing to find what they owe.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/action-items-from-your-recordings?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=action-items-from-your-recordings

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #ScreenRecording

title: One question at a time forms
text:
You can now build one-question-at-a-time forms in NeetoForm.

Each question gets its own screen, with Previous and Next buttons to move between them. In the builder, questions sit on separate cards in the order respondents will see them. Pick the One question at a time option when you create a form from scratch; the layout is set at creation.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetoform.com/changelogs/one-question-at-a-time-forms?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=one-question-at-a-time-forms

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Forms

title: Redesigned automation rule builder
text:
The automation rule builder in NeetoChat is now a sentence you can read at a glance.

A rule like "assign conversations started on the pricing page to a sales agent" shows exactly that. The two email actions are now one Send email action where you pick the recipient. Existing rules keep working and open in the new builder.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/redesigned-automation-rule-builder?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=redesigned-automation-rule-builder

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #LiveChat

title: Charge a client's saved payment method
text:
Now you can charge a client's saved payment method when booking a recurring series for them in NeetoCal.

Each session, including the first, is charged automatically before it starts, so there is no payment link to send. The option appears on the payment step when the client has a payment method saved from an earlier Stripe payment.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/charge-a-client-s-saved-payment-method?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=charge-a-client-s-saved-payment-method

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Social media links in the intro page footer
text:
Your NeetoCal intro page footer can now link to your social media profiles.

Choose the third footer variant and paste your links, and clients can open your Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn or Twitter profile in one click. Platforms you leave without a link stay hidden, and you can add other platforms with your own icon.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/social-media-links-in-the-intro-page-footer?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=social-media-links-in-the-intro-page-footer

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Apply a discount when booking for a client
text:
NeetoCal now lets you apply a discount code when booking a paid meeting for a client.

Enter the code on the payment step and the payment link you send opens with the discount already applied, so the client pays only the discounted amount. If the code covers the full fee, reserve the slot and the booking is confirmed right away.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/apply-a-discount-when-booking-for-a-client?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=apply-a-discount-when-booking-for-a-client

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Filter tickets by customer or custom field through the API
text:
Now you can fetch one customer's tickets through the NeetoDesk API in a single call.

The List tickets API takes a customer filter, by email address or customer ID, and a custom field filter. If you store an account ID in a custom field, you can get every ticket for that account without paging through all of your tickets.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/filter-tickets-by-customer-or-custom-field-through-the-api?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=filter-tickets-by-customer-or-custom-field-through-the-api

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Recover unfinished recordings
text:
NeetoRecord no longer loses a recording when the browser crashes or closes partway through.

Everything uploaded up to that point is kept. The recordings page shows a notice about the interrupted recording, and the Chrome extension asks about it the next time you open it. Choose Recover to finish it with what was captured, or Discard to delete it.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/recover-unfinished-recordings?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=recover-unfinished-recordings

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #ScreenRecording

title: Lists and subheadings on intro pages
text:
Intro page section descriptions in NeetoCal now support lists, subheadings, underline and strikethrough.

Break a long description into bulleted or numbered points, or add a subheading so clients can scan what you offer. There is also a new About us 6 layout with no image, which gives the title and description the full width of the page for longer text.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/lists-and-subheadings-on-intro-pages?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=lists-and-subheadings-on-intro-pages

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Multi-step forms with page breaks
text:
NeetoForm now lets you split a long form into several pages.

Add a Page break element wherever a new page should begin. Respondents move through with Next and Previous, each page is validated before they continue, and their answers stay put when they go back. A page where conditional logic hides every question is skipped automatically.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetoform.com/changelogs/multi-step-forms-with-page-breaks?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=multi-step-forms-with-page-breaks

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Forms

title: Watch time and engagement analytics
text:
Analytics in NeetoRecord now show whether viewers watched a recording to the end, not just how many times it played.

Open a recording's Analytics tab for average view duration, average engagement, and a chart of the parts viewers watched, skipped or rewatched. The Audience view lists signed-in viewers with a heat strip of the moments each one played.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/watch-time-and-engagement-analytics?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=watch-time-and-engagement-analytics

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #ScreenRecording

title: Conversation names in unread-message emails
text:
Unread-message emails from NeetoChat now name the conversation they're about.

The subject and body carry the conversation's title, or the visitor's first message when there is no title. A visitor with several conversations can tell which one you replied to, and Gmail threads each conversation separately. The Reply now link opens the conversation where it started.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/conversation-names-in-unread-message-emails?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=conversation-names-in-unread-message-emails

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #LiveChat

title: Override notifications for a scheduling link
text:
You can now choose which emails and SMS each scheduling link sends in NeetoCal.

Stop confirmation SMS on one link while your other links keep sending them, all from the link's Settings tab. There is also a new SMS notifications page in the Admin panel, so you can turn off any booking SMS for your whole workspace.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/override-notifications-for-a-scheduling-link?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=override-notifications-for-a-scheduling-link

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: NeetoEngage integration
text:
Feature requests from customers can now go from a NeetoDesk ticket straight to NeetoEngage.

Add a private note that starts with "fr" and the request becomes a new feature request or a vote on an existing one. The customer's name and email stay out of the public title and description and go in a private note. Now in early access.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/neetoengage-integration?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=neetoengage-integration

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Attach files to ticket updates and drafts through the API
text:
The NeetoDesk API can now attach files when you update a ticket or save a draft reply.

For larger files, the new Reserve an attachment upload call sends the file straight to storage. The NeetoDesk MCP server can attach files too, so your AI assistant can add a file to a ticket, a reply or a draft.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/attach-files-to-ticket-updates-and-drafts-through-the-api?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=attach-files-to-ticket-updates-and-drafts-through-the-api

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Cc people when creating a ticket
text:
Now you can add people in Cc while creating a ticket in NeetoDesk.

The new ticket form has a Cc field next to the customer's email. It suggests existing customers as you type and accepts any email address. Everyone you add stays on the ticket and gets your team's replies, starting with the first one.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/cc-people-when-creating-a-ticket?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cc-people-when-creating-a-ticket

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Automation rules that read as a sentence
text:
Automation rules in NeetoForm now read as a plain sentence.

Build a rule by choosing each part in order: when a submission is created, then send an email to the form submitter. Email and SMS are grouped, so you pick the channel first and then the recipient. If something can't be used, like SMS without Twilio, the builder says why.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetoform.com/changelogs/automation-rules-that-read-as-a-sentence?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automation-rules-that-read-as-a-sentence

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Forms

title: Unread replies when the widget is hidden
text:
NeetoChat no longer lets a reply go unseen when your site keeps the widget hidden.

Turn on Show widget on new reply under Widget modes, and the launcher reappears with an unread badge the moment an agent replies. If your site has its own help menu, use the new onUnreadChange callback or NeetoChat.contextualHelp.getUnreadCount() to show the count there instead.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/unread-replies-when-the-widget-is-hidden?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=unread-replies-when-the-widget-is-hidden

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #LiveChat

title: Slack thread link on tickets
text:
NeetoDesk tickets now link straight to their Slack thread.

When an automation rule posts a ticket to Slack, the ticket's sidebar shows a View in Slack link and when it was posted. Teams that discuss tickets in Slack can jump to the right thread to reply or set a reminder, without searching the channel.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/slack-thread-link-on-tickets?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=slack-thread-link-on-tickets

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Customize approval and rejection emails
text:
The approval and rejection emails in NeetoCal can now sound like you.

Edit the approval request to the host, the pending email to the client, and the rejection email, for your whole workspace or for a single scheduling link. The rejection email can also include the reason you declined the request.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/customize-approval-and-rejection-emails?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=customize-approval-and-rejection-emails

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Search inside ticket conversations
text:
Search in NeetoDesk now looks inside ticket conversations.

It covers customer messages, replies and notes, and shows the matching text under each result. So a ticket is easy to find when all you remember is a word the customer wrote. Open search from the sidebar or with Cmd + K.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/search-inside-ticket-conversations?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=search-inside-ticket-conversations

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: IP restriction
text:
NeetoDesk now lets you limit access to your workspace to specific IP addresses or IP ranges.

Turn it on under Admin Panel > IP Restriction and only people on your trusted networks, such as your office network or company VPN, can reach your data. Your current IP is added automatically, so you don't lock yourself out.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/ip-restriction?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ip-restriction

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Look up contacts with the API
text:
The NeetoChat API can now look up contacts directly.

Fetch one contact by ID, or list contacts filtered by email, user identifier or both. Each result includes the name, email, phone number, traits and contact field values. Integrations no longer have to go through a conversation to reach a person's details.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetochat.com/changelogs/look-up-contacts-with-the-api?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=look-up-contacts-with-the-api

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #LiveChat

title: Send automations only to first-time clients
text:
You can now send a NeetoCal automation only to first-time clients.

Each automation rule's email or SMS can go to first-time clients, returning clients, or both. A welcome email goes out after a client's first meeting, and regulars stop getting it every time they book. Existing rules keep sending to both.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/send-automations-only-to-first-time-clients?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=send-automations-only-to-first-time-clients

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Reschedule a group meeting for everyone
text:
You can now move a whole group meeting to a new time in one step in NeetoCal.

Pick the new time once and everyone who booked moves with it. Each person gets an updated invitation, reminders and the calendar event move too, and you get a single email instead of a flood.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/reschedule-a-group-meeting-for-everyone?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=reschedule-a-group-meeting-for-everyone

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Video uploads and more in the API, MCP and CLI
text:
The NeetoRecord API can now upload your videos.

Send an MP4 of up to 2 GB through the API, the CLI or an AI assistant connected through the MCP server, without opening the browser. All three now share the same recording filters and can read or generate action items, and AI assistants can manage team members.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetorecord.com/changelogs/video-uploads-and-more-in-the-api-mcp-and-cli?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=video-uploads-and-more-in-the-api-mcp-and-cli

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #ScreenRecording

title: Follow and unfollow tickets
text:
You can now follow any ticket in NeetoDesk, even one that isn't assigned to you.

Open the Followers section in the ticket's sidebar and click Follow to get an email for every reply. The section also shows whether you're getting emails for that ticket, and Unfollow stops them when you no longer need them.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/follow-and-unfollow-tickets?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=follow-and-unfollow-tickets

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Images on intro page service cards
text:
Service cards on your NeetoCal intro page can now show an image.

Pick the Services 5 variant and every card starts with an image chosen for your profession, or upload your own from the Services list. Clients see what each service looks like before they book, not just read about it.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/images-on-intro-page-service-cards?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=images-on-intro-page-service-cards

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Ticket status in search results
text:
NeetoDesk search results now show each ticket's status.

The status appears as a tag beside the ticket number and subject, in the team member label and color you set, so custom statuses look the same as they do on the ticket. When several tickets share a subject, you can tell which one is still open before opening any of them.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetodesk.com/changelogs/ticket-status-in-search-results?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ticket-status-in-search-results

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #CustomerSupport

title: Automatic redirect to your custom domain
text:
Your custom domain is now the one address for your NeetoCal public pages.

Anyone who opens a scheduling link, intro page or routing form on your NeetoCal subdomain lands on the same page on your custom domain, and links you've already shared keep working. Search engines and link previews get your custom domain too.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/automatic-redirect-to-your-custom-domain?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=automatic-redirect-to-your-custom-domain

#BuildInPublic #SaaS #Scheduling

title: Customize meeting appearance before picking a calendar
text:
NeetoCal no longer asks you to pick a calendar before customizing how meetings look.

Set the meeting name, body and (for Google Calendar) color whenever it suits you. We save the layout and use it as soon as you choose a calendar, for Google Calendar, Outlook and iCloud.

To know more, read the changelog: https://engage.neetocal.com/changelogs/customize-meeting-appearance-even-before-connecting-calendar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=customize-meeting-appearance-even-before-connecting-calendar
